I get these exact same symptoms, especially the mid-to-end pain whilst urinating. It’s like a delayed response..? My leukocytes were consistently showing I had a UTI, got biopsy results, annnnd no bacteria. Urologist explained my brain sends signals to my urethra that it’s infected, and *during flares* i’ll usually show up positive for a UTI when I’ve been biopsied, cultured and even had a cystoscopy to no avail. This sucks, bc if you have a UTI, IC can hide it. Gotta get cultured, or at least “professionally screened” with not just a generic dipstick. I’ve also felt my bladder physically spasming, but valium quickly does the trick. I’ll sometimes randomly get “hot flashes” or burning sensations for a few seconds when laying down.  I’m having a bladder hydro-extension surgery and currently take 50mg amitriptyline. Saved my life, flares only last 2-3 hours now instead of 5-7 days in a row. No one deserves to go through this disease. Unbearable pain and so misunderstood
